# IvPlayer

IvPlayer is a media player for Windows, Android phones, Android TV boxes, the web, and LG webOS TVs at https://ivplayer.tr/

It plays the user's own authorized M3U/M3U8 playlist. IvPlayer does not provide TV channels, IPTV subscriptions, or channel packages.

Current clients (not Play Store / not Microsoft Store):
- Windows 10/11 64-bit installer: https://ivplayer.tr/downloads/IvPlayer-Setup-1.0.0.exe
- Android phone + Android TV (same APK, sideload): https://ivplayer.tr/downloads/IvPlayer-1.0.0.apk
- Web player: https://ivplayer.tr/app/
- LG TV: LG Content Store

Phone UI is landscape/touch. Android TV uses a 10-foot D-pad UI. After install, the app shows a 12-character device code (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Buy a player license (not content) at https://ivplayer.tr/activation.html then tap “Lisansı kontrol et”.

Software licenses (1 year 299 TRY, lifetime 799 TRY) — player license only.

- Site: https://ivplayer.tr/

- Support: https://ivplayer.tr/support.html
